history.content: Checked your calendar for the week (Mon Sep 21 through today). Honest answer: it was nearly empty. The only things on it are all today and forward: BigCo interview, today, 2:00 PM Gym, today, 6:30 PM Dentist, tomorrow, 9:00 AM Team standup, Wed, 9:15 AM Dinner with Dana, Wed, 7:30 PM So if last week felt busy, it wasn't because of scheduled events, nothing was on the calendar. What I haven't checked: your email threads and reminders, which could hold commitments that never made it onto the calendar. Want me to scan those to see if anything was eating your week?
